name: Baker Hughes
summary:
Baker Hughes (BKR) reported earnings of $0.64 per share on revenue of $6.74 billion for the . The consensus earnings estimate was $0.51 per share on revenue of $6.49 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.53 per share. The company beat expectations by 20.75% while revenue fell 2.43% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

Baker Hughes is an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and with operations in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
subject: Baker Hughes Beat Expectations
